kxrde01.title: Gemini plans a bus to the last stop
kxrde01.caption:
The plan was no plan, and the last stop turned out to be a car park.
A tiny soup window saved the night, and THE STARS still gave it a 9. Would you get on the bus?

kxrde02.title: Cancer plans walking shelter dogs
kxrde02.caption:
Six dogs, one system, and Capricorn spun into a maypole by minute two.
The shyest dog picked Capricorn and the oldest one got Cancer crying. Muddy, and a 10. Would you sign up?

kxrde03.title: Leo plans a living-room talent show
kxrde03.caption:
Leo booked six acts for Leo and gave Virgo act seven.
The card trick flopped, and Leo answered with the loudest standing ovation of the night. Who claps hardest for you?

kxrde04.title: Capricorn plans half a date
kxrde04.caption:
Capricorn planned a greenhouse with a printed map. Sag planned a dance class.
The freeze in the dance circle didn't last, and both envelopes said the same thing. Which half would you plan?

kxrde05.title: Aquarius plans a laundromat date
kxrde05.caption:
Laundry night with talk cards, and the first question got a very specific answer.
One red jumper later everything was pink, and Taurus loved it. What small thing makes your day?

kxsre01.title: Virgo silently reviews a first date
kxsre01.caption:
Virgo scored the arrival a 4 before the jacket was even the right way out.
Then Sag remembered the puppy and gave up the last dumpling. Ever been wrong about a first impression?

kxsre02.title: Scorpio and the six phone checks
kxsre02.caption:
Six phone checks, and Scorpio braced for the worst every time.
Check six was the group chat cheering them on. What did you assume last time someone checked their phone?

kxsre03.title: Capricorn meets the texter in person
kxsre03.caption:
Three months of all-caps texts, then a hug-handshake collision at the door.
The quiet ended with both of them snorting at the same second. Who is louder in texts than in person?

kxsre04.title: Taurus and the ex mentions
kxsre04.caption:
Four mentions of the ex before dessert, and Taurus kept count.
Then Libra said it plainly, still a bit sad but here, and the tiramisu came with two spoons. Is honesty the real comeback?

kxsre05.title: Pisces tries not to cry for a whole date
kxsre05.caption:
Rule one of tonight's review: no crying. The counter broke at the lemon cake.
By the napkin constellation it hit 99. What tiny gesture gets you every time?

kxsre06.title: Aries reviews ten claw-machine tries
kxsre06.caption:
Nine misses, zero words allowed, one Aries screaming on mute.
Try ten came up with a tiny star, and Cancer never stopped smiling. Who in your life just will not give up on you?
